measurement_limits: Resources sampled every ~2 s with nvidia-smi and psutil from an external logger, not the application. VRAM is whole-device and includes other applications (~0.9 GiB idle desktop baseline). Process RSS sums musubi-tuner python trees. Disk deltas are free-space changes on C: and include unrelated activity. GPU clock, temperature and throttle-reason samples count only rows above 50% utilisation. Seconds per step is the final tqdm average. Runs 352bca2c, 68cb10f0 and da1d21c7 ran after the loggers stopped and have no resource samples. GPU power limits were set by the owner in MSI Afterburner and are read from nvidia-smi: 280 W for the Wan runs except A3 (350 W), 245 W for the H3 probes; runs without samples have no recorded limit. The fan profile was steepened by the owner during A3. The backend ran successive main revisions during the day (fixes for #27-#30 landed between runs); application_revision is the revision at the end of the trial.
